_comment: Bidirectional inverse resolution: the schema's inverses map is one-directional (parent_of -> child_of). Removing from the child side (child_of, the right-hand verb, not a map key) must still strip the parent_of edge on the parent page via reverse lookup. Setup makes parent_of [[rp-child]] (auto-closes child_of [[rp-parent]] on rp-child); removing child_of from rp-child must clear parent_of from rp-parent too.
